input.title: Undo/Redo Nudge Up:
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - m
    - x
- b
  - m
    - y
``` 

1. Set the cursor on b/m
2. Command: Nudge Up
4. Undo

## Current Behavior


```
Error: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'R.length')
```

## Expected Behavior

Undo "Nudge Up" without an error.
